name: Aihara Hina
source:
The daughter of Chidori's mentor, she is studying at the restaurant to someday become a Head Hostess at her own restaurant. She makes a lot of mistakes, and is quite self-conscious about it, so she and Ryouichi seem to have a lot in common. She's very determined and admires Ryouichi for not giving up.

[from [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Come_See_Me_Tonight]Wikipedia[/url]]
